serves: 2
---

Toss it just before serving.

## Ingredients

### For the salad

- 1 bunch [coriander](/ingredients/coriander.md), leaves picked
- 2 [spring onions](/ingredients/spring-onion.md), sliced
- 1 [red onion](/ingredients/onion.md), thinly sliced

## Method

1. **Toss.** Toss everything together.
